description_good_justification:
Top of README describes Attaform as a schema-driven Vue 3 / Nuxt forms library with Zod validation, in one paragraph. The npm package page mirrors the same description.

Evidence: [README.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/README.md)
interact_justification:
README has install + quickstart for `pnpm add attaform`. CONTRIBUTING.md covers feedback and contribution flow. GitHub Issues is the feedback channel.

Evidence: [README.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/README.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [Issues](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues)
contribution_justification:
CONTRIBUTING.md covers dev setup, the `pnpm check` gate, branch / commit conventions (Conventional Commits), and the PR-flow expectation.

Evidence: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
contribution_requirements_justification:
CONTRIBUTING.md states the test-required policy for `src/runtime/` changes and lists the conventional-commit prefixes. ESLint config + TypeScript strict mode codify the style requirements; PRs that fail `pnpm check` cannot merge once branch protection is in place.

Evidence: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [eslint.config.js](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/eslint.config.js)
license_location_justification:
Root-level `LICENSE` file, recognized by GitHub's license-detection UI.

Evidence: [LICENSE](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/LICENSE)
documentation_basics_justification:
Docs site (Nuxt + @nuxt/content) hosts the full reference; README has the quickstart. Live docs deployed via the `deploy-docs.yml` workflow.

Evidence: [apps/site (docs portal)](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/tree/main/apps/site), [README.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/README.md)
documentation_interface_justification:
Per-symbol reference pages: `useForm`, `useRegister`, `useWizard`, `injectForm`, plus schema, validation, persistence, undo/redo. Every public API symbol has its own page with the inference-first DX walkthroughs the library is built around.

Evidence: [apps/site/content/docs](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/tree/main/apps/site/content/docs)
sites_https_justification:
GitHub and npm registry both HTTPS-only. The Vercel-hosted docs deployment is also HTTPS by default.

Evidence: <https://github.com/attaform/Attaform>, <https://www.npmjs.com/package/attaform>
discussion_justification:
GitHub Issues + Pull Requests provide URL-addressable, searchable, threaded discussion. Each issue and PR has a stable URL.

Evidence: [Issues](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues), [Pull Requests](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pulls)
english_justification:
Every persisted artifact is in English.

Evidence: README, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, all docs pages
maintained_justification:
Active development with multiple commits per week and weekly-to-bi-weekly releases (current: 0.19.0, May 2026). Issues responded to within days. Active maintainer signal is the strongest signal Scorecard's `Maintained` check already grades at 10/10.

Evidence: [Recent commits](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/commits/main), [Recent releases](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/releases)
repo_track_justification:
Git history. Commit authorship is verified by GPG signatures on tagged releases ([Pinned-Dependencies](https://securityscorecards.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/attaform/Attaform) check confirms).

Evidence: [Commit history](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/commits/main)
repo_interim_justification:
Every commit lands via PR; the full development history (~300+ PRs as of May 2026) is the interim record between npm releases.

Evidence: [Commit history](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/commits/main), [Pull Requests](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pulls)
repo_distributed_justification:
Git is the canonical example given by the criterion text.

Evidence: Git (via GitHub)
version_unique_justification:
semver-versioned npm releases; each `v0.X.Y` is a unique tag + npm version.

Evidence: [Releases](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/releases), [npm versions](https://www.npmjs.com/package/attaform?activeTab=versions)
version_semver_justification:
Strict SemVer. Pre-1.0 cycle uses the `0.MINOR.PATCH` convention; breaking changes bump the minor (per SemVer §4).

Evidence: [package.json](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/package.json), [Releases](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/releases)
version_tags_justification:
Every release has a `vX.Y.Z` git tag. Tags are GPG-signed (`git tag -v vX.Y.Z` verifies against the maintainer's published key). Verified by the publish workflow.

Evidence: [Tags](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/tags)
release_notes_justification:
Three-layer notes: handwritten `CHANGELOG.md` for the curated narrative, auto-generated `RELEASES.md` for the PR-by-PR ledger, GitHub Releases for the in-platform view.

Evidence: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md), [RELEASES.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/RELEASES.md), [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/releases)
release_notes_vulns_justification:
SECURITY.md states the disclosure policy: every fixed vulnerability is mirrored to CHANGELOG.md with reporter credit + CVE (when assigned). Recent prototype-pollution remediation (PRs #308, #309, #310) is documented in CHANGELOG.md under the relevant minor.

Evidence: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/SECURITY.md), [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
report_process_justification:
GitHub Issues for non-security bugs; SECURITY.md documents the Private Vulnerability Reporting channel for security bugs.

Evidence: [Issues](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues), [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
report_tracker_justification:
GitHub Issues with labels for triage, severity, and area.

Evidence: [Issues](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues)
report_responses_justification:
Solo-maintainer project; every issue has a maintainer response within days. The Issues "closed" tab shows the historical rate.

Evidence: [Closed issues](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed)
enhancement_responses_justification:
Same rapid-response pattern as bug reports. Enhancement requests are responded to and either accepted (file PR), deferred (label + comment), or rejected (closed with rationale).

Evidence: [Issues with enhancement label](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement)
report_archive_justification:
GitHub Issues + PRs are the public archive. Every state transition is timestamped and searchable.

Evidence: [Issues](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/issues?q=is%3Aissue), [Pull Requests](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pulls?q=is%3Apr)
vulnerability_report_process_justificati:
SECURITY.md is the published process. GitHub also surfaces it under the repo's Security tab via the "Report a vulnerability" affordance.

Evidence: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
vulnerability_report_private_justificati:
Primary channel: GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting at `https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/security/advisories/new` (encrypted advisory workflow, two-party visible only). Backup: email `oswald.kay.chisala@gmail.com` with subject prefix `[security][attaform]`.

Evidence: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
vulnerability_report_response_justificat:
SECURITY.md commits to 5-business-day initial acknowledgement (well inside the 14-day requirement). Triage outcome within 10 business days. Critical fixes ship within 14 days.

Evidence: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
build_justification:
`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm dev:prepare` bootstraps from source. The Docker-based dev flow (`make install` / `make dev`) is the documented setup. `pnpm prepack` (unbuild) is the production build.

Evidence: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [package.json](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/package.json), [Makefile](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/Makefile)
build_common_tools_justification:
pnpm, Node.js 22, TypeScript, Vue 3, Nuxt 3+, unbuild. All canonical in the JS ecosystem.

Evidence: [package.json](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/package.json), [build.config.ts](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/build.config.ts)
build_floss_tools_justification:
dependency-review.yml's license-policy block denies AGPL/GPL/LGPL but accepts permissive FLOSS licenses (MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, BSD).

Evidence: all dependencies are FLOSS-licensed (verified by [Pinned-Dependencies](https://securityscorecards.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/attaform/Attaform) check at 10/10 and [dependency-review.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml))
test_justification:
Vitest (MIT-licensed) is the test runner. 3,580+ tests as of May 2026.

Evidence: [test/](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/tree/main/test), [vitest.config.ts](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/vitest.config.ts)
test_invocation_justification:
`pnpm test` and `pnpm check` (full pipeline) are the documented entry points. `pnpm test <file>` runs a single test file. CONTRIBUTING.md documents both.

Evidence: [package.json scripts](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/package.json)
test_most_justification:
Current coverage: 87% statements, 81% branches, 88% functions, 91% lines. Coverage budget enforced by `pnpm check:coverage`; PRs that drop coverage fail CI.

Evidence: [Coverage report (per matrix.yml artifact)](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/actions/workflows/matrix.yml)
test_continuous_integration_justificatio:
`matrix.yml` runs full `pnpm check` (lint, format, typecheck, site build, tests, size, bench, coverage) on every push to `main` and every PR. `peer-matrix.yml` runs the Vue 3.5+, Vite 5/6, Nuxt 3/4 compatibility sweep weekly.

Evidence: [.github/workflows/matrix.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/matrix.yml)
test_policy_justification:
CONTRIBUTING.md "What NOT to touch" section explicitly requires "matching test" for any change under `src/runtime/lib/core/transforms/`. PR template (when added) enforces the same.

Evidence: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
tests_are_added_justification:
Recent example: PRs #308, #309 (prototype-pollution remediation) each landed dedicated regression tests in `test/core/persistence/proto-pollution.test.ts`, `test/core/set-at-path-prototype-pollution.test.ts`, etc. Every feature PR includes its matching test file.

Evidence: [Recent PRs adding tests](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aclosed)
tests_documented_added_justification:
Section "What NOT to touch" documents the matching-test requirement for `src/runtime/lib/core/transforms/` changes.

Evidence: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
warnings_justification:
ESLint (flat config with `@typescript-eslint`, `eslint-plugin-vue`, `eslint-plugin-promise`). TypeScript with `strict: true` and `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`. Vue SFC linting via `eslint-plugin-vue`. zizmor (pedantic persona) lints workflows.

Evidence: [eslint.config.js](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/eslint.config.js), [tsconfig.json](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/tsconfig.json)
warnings_fixed_justification:
`pnpm check` runs `eslint .` with `--max-warnings 0`. Any new warning fails CI; no warnings can land on `main`.

Evidence: [matrix.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/matrix.yml)
warnings_strict_justification:
TypeScript `strict: true` includes the full strict family (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, strictFunctionTypes, strictBindCallApply, alwaysStrict, strictPropertyInitialization, useUnknownInCatchVariables, noImplicitThis). Plus `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noUnusedParameters`. ESLint config is the project's own flat config with conservative defaults, per-rule curated rather than extended from a permissive recommended preset.

Evidence: [eslint.config.js](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/eslint.config.js), [tsconfig.json](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/tsconfig.json)
know_secure_design_justification:
The maintainer (Oswald Chisala) is a full-time senior software engineer with experience covering secure design (least-privilege OIDC flows, supply-chain hardening, input-sanitisation patterns). Recent demonstrations: scoped OIDC publish surface in publish-npm.yml after the May 2026 Mini Shai-Hulud worm; `Object.create(null)` proto-less storage sweep across the runtime (PRs #308, #309, #310); CodeQL triage closing 6 first-run findings (PR #307).

Evidence: Recent commit history demonstrating threat-modelling
know_common_errors_justification:
PR #307 remediated polynomial ReDoS, prototype pollution, TOCTOU file race, untrusted HTTP→FS data flow, FS→HTTP data flow, and identity replacement. Six distinct CodeQL categories, each with a targeted fix that doesn't just suppress the finding.

Evidence: [PR #307](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/307), [PR #308](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/308), [PR #309](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/309)
crypto_published_justification:
Attaform is a forms library; it does not implement or invoke cryptography directly. Its publish pipeline uses HTTPS (TLS 1.3) via npm, GPG signatures via OpenPGP, and Sigstore via `actions/attest-build-provenance`. All published, peer-reviewed protocols.

Evidence: N/A (no first-party cryptographic protocol use)
crypto_call_justification:
No cryptographic code in `src/`.

Evidence: N/A (no first-party cryptographic code)
crypto_floss_justification: Attaform has no cryptography-dependent runtime functionality.
crypto_keylength_justification: No first-party key generation or selection. The OpenSSF Sigstore-backed attestation flow (used by `actions/attest-build-provenance` per PR #311) is internally bound to current NIST recommendations.
crypto_pfs_justification: No key-agreement mechanisms; all transport is HTTPS (TLS handles PFS at the transport layer outside Attaform's surface).
crypto_password_storage_justification: Attaform does not store passwords. Forms may collect password input, but persistence of that value is the consumer application's responsibility. Attaform's `persistence/` layer treats sensitive paths as opt-in with explicit acknowledgement requirements (see `persistence/index.ts` sensitive-leaf scrub).
crypto_random_justification: Attaform does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces. Internal `field-ids.ts` uses string-stem normalisation, not random IDs.
delivery_mitm_justification:
`publishConfig.registry: "https://registry.npmjs.org/"` (HTTPS-only). The publish workflow uses npm Trusted Publishing OIDC, eliminating any MITM-able token. Git clone over HTTPS or SSH.

Evidence: [package.json](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/package.json), [.npmrc](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.npmrc)
delivery_unsigned_justification:
`pnpm-lock.yaml` pins every dependency by SHA-512 integrity hash (lockfile v9). Publication includes `--provenance` (npm provenance) and GitHub Attestation (`actions/attest-build-provenance`, see PR #311); consumer can verify with `npm audit signatures` or `gh attestation verify`.

Evidence: [.npmrc](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.npmrc), [pnpm-lock.yaml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/pnpm-lock.yaml)
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat:
Zero open security advisories at submission time. Recent CodeQL findings (May 2026) were remediated within 48 hours of detection (PRs #307–#310).

Evidence: [Security tab](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/security)
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica:
The proto-pollution sweep landed across three PRs within a 72-hour window of CodeQL surfacing the findings. SECURITY.md commits to a 14-day-or-less fix window for critical issues; recent evidence beats that target by an order of magnitude.

Evidence: [PR #307](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/307), [PR #308](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/308), [PR #309](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/309)
no_leaked_credentials_justification:
No `.env` files committed. The publish pipeline uses OIDC Trusted Publishing (no NPM_TOKEN to leak) + GPG signing via `GPG_PRIVATE_KEY` repo secret (write-only access, scoped to the Production environment). GitHub secret-scanning + push-protection are active.

Evidence: GitHub Secret Scanning (enabled by default on public repos), npm Trusted Publishing eliminates the `NPM_TOKEN` secret
static_analysis_justification:
CodeQL with the `security-extended` query suite for JavaScript/TypeScript. ESLint with type-aware rules (`@typescript-eslint`). TypeScript compiler strict mode. zizmor (pedantic) for workflows.

Evidence: [.github/workflows/codeql.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml)
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j:
`security-extended` includes prototype pollution, ReDoS, path traversal, code injection, taint-flow chains, SSRF, eval-injection. The standard OWASP/CWE high-priority set. Demonstrated by the PR #307 remediation surfacing real findings under each major category.

Evidence: [.github/workflows/codeql.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml)
static_analysis_fixed_justification:
First-run CodeQL findings remediated in PR #307 (close-out within 24 hours). Subsequent runs (PRs #308–#310) addressed deeper architectural concerns (sanitise-not-block proto-less storage). Zero open code-scanning alerts at submission time.

Evidence: [PR #307](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/pull/307), [Security tab](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/security)
static_analysis_often_justification:
CodeQL triggers: push to main, every PR, weekly cron (Tue 03:00 UTC). Per-commit on every change to main; per-PR on every code review.

Evidence: [.github/workflows/codeql.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml)
dynamic_analysis_justification:
Vitest unit + integration tests (3,580+) run on every commit. Coverage report enforces branch and statement budgets. `peer-matrix.yml` runs cross-version compatibility tests weekly (Vue 3.5+, Vite 5/6, Nuxt 3/4).

Evidence: [test/](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/tree/main/test), [.github/workflows/matrix.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/matrix.yml)
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Attaform is implemented in TypeScript (compiled to memory-safe JavaScript). No native code in the publish surface.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi:
Vitest config enables strict mode. Tests use explicit assertions (`expect`) throughout, no soft-pass patterns. CI fails the run on any assertion failure.

Evidence: [vitest.config.ts](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/vitest.config.ts), [test/](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/tree/main/test)
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification:
`matrix.yml` blocks merge on any failing test or coverage regression. Recent dynamic-analysis-surfaced failures (the validation-signal regressions across the tune/default-display-state and perf/skip-unchanged-revalidation branches) were addressed within the same PR cycle.

Evidence: [matrix.yml](https://github.com/attaform/Attaform/blob/main/.github/workflows/matrix.yml)
